aaj ka din bhee nikal gaya? aaj kee kaurbaanee kal kee paartee hai. pen uthaao, shuroo karo.
ek pal ke lie socho. dhokha kisee aur ko naheen, khud ko de rahe ho. pen uthaao, shuroo karo.
sach kahoon to dar lag raha hai. padhaaaee ka majaa sirph padhane ke baad aata hai. ek savaal abhee hal karo. 💔

ek savaal poochhoon? kata-ऑph kisee ka intajaaar naheen karatee. shuroo karo, baakee sab apane aap ho jaaega. 💔

aaj ka din bhee nikal gaya? itana tailent hai, bas use kaam men laao. jo hua so hua, abhee se shuroo. 😤
